steps.a: The code is right and my expectation is wrong: 24 * 0.20 = 4.8, which rounds half-up to 5. I meant a case that rounds down; 22 * 0.20 = 4.4 gives 4.

Added table-driven tests for both functions: per-line half-up rounding (including a round-down case), zero and reduced rates, and the three reverse-charge combinations. One expectation of mine was wrong (4.8 rounds to 5) and was replaced by a real round-down case; everything passes and the package is at 100% statement coverage.
